title: Richards Fixed-Horizon Error-Bound Estimator Qualification
purpose: Determine whether same-horizon Richards endpoint defects can be converted into a conservative dimensional upper bound on remaining endpoint head error. This work unit does not choose an application/scientific temporal tolerance and does not admit production use.

mathematical_candidate.endpoint_family: x_N is the Richards endpoint state obtained over the same physical [t0,t1] using N equal internal substeps
mathematical_candidate.contraction_ratio: q_N = d_2N/d_N when both defects are above the numerical floor
mathematical_candidate.candidate_global_cap: q_cap is derived only from the frozen calibration matrix as the maximum resolved q_N at and beyond a candidate minimum refinement depth Nmin
mathematical_candidate.two_trajectory_bound_target: For x_2N, B_2N = q_cap/(1-q_cap) * d_N, conditional on the independently tested profile assumption that every future defect contracts by no more than q_cap.
mathematical_candidate.qualification_test: B_2N must upper-bound the observed max-head error of x_2N against a much finer same-horizon finite reference for every calibration and held-out case, while all future resolved q values also remain <= q_cap.
not_claimed: Nref is an exact analytical solution
geometric contraction is a theorem for Richards flow
q_cap is universal outside the frozen profile
B_2N is a scientific/application acceptance tolerance

gate_A_calibration.role: derive candidate Nmin and q_cap only
gate_A_calibration.selection_rule: For each candidate Nmin in [1,2,4,8,16,32,64], derive q_cap as the maximum resolved future contraction ratio over all calibration cases from Nmin onward. The first Nmin with finite q_cap<1 and conservative B_2N for every calibration case is the sole Gate B candidate. No rounding, safety factor or manually chosen margin may be added.

gate_B_held_out.role: independent falsification of the frozen Gate A Nmin and q_cap
pass_conditions: all trajectories required for the test converge
hard mass gate passes for every trajectory
every resolved future q_N at and beyond frozen Nmin is <= frozen q_cap
B_2N computed only from d_N and frozen q_cap is >= observed max-head error of x_2N against N=2048 reference for every case
no held-out-dependent adjustment of Nmin, q_cap, matrix or formula

finite_reference_controls.tail_diagnostic: also report max-head difference x_1024 versus x_2048
finite_reference_controls.interpretation: Held-out bound pass is relative to a finite same-horizon reference. If the reference-tail diagnostic is not small enough relative to the candidate bound or observed remaining error, qualification must remain conditional or fail closed rather than treating N=2048 as exact.

cost_boundary.production_candidate_if_bound_qualifies: two same-horizon trajectories at Nmin and 2*Nmin are sufficient to evaluate B_2N if the frozen contraction profile itself is admitted later
